description: Row counts m of the tall a [m, 16] in the KernelBench level 1 problem 9 (tall-skinny matrix multiplication) product, at its k = 16 inner size and its m = 16384 case's output width n = 16384. The original cases made the output square (n = m, up to 65536^2, 17 GB); a scenario fixes n, so m varies alone, up to the problem's tallest m of 65536 (a 4 GB output). Rows 640 to 65536 are timed (102x, 42 MB to 4.3 GB of output writes); 1, 3, 100 and 5000 are correctness-only boundary shapes.
